name: MCSR6N1
tagline: 12th Gen Intel Core six-port appliance with DDR4
description: MCSR6N1 offers Intel Core i3-1215U / i5-1235U / i7-1265U, up to 64GB DDR4, six Intel i226-V 2.5GbE ports, NVMe and dual SATA. Its 145.6 x 145.4 x 53.6 mm enclosure uses DC 12–19V input.

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 1 x HDMI 1.4; 1 x DP 1.4a; 1 x Type-C

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: 1 x 4Pin CPUFAN; 1 x COM Pin; 1 x USB Pin

specs.label: BIOS
specs.value: AMI EFI BIOS supports auto power on

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: 1 x Power button; 1 x HDMI 1.4; 1 x DP 1.4a; 1 x RST Button; 2 x USB 3.0; 1 x USB 3.2; 1 x Type-C; 1 x TF card

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 1 x DC12-19V Power interface; 6 x Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet port; 1 x Hard disk indicator; 1 x Power indicator
